description: Address 5 post-review issues: campaign insert missing owner, admin profile ignoring dark mode, subscriptions swallowing errors silently, admin profile sign-out not awaited, campaign dialog missing validation UX.
steps: Add 'created_by': SupabaseService.currentUser?.id to the campaign insert map in campaign_control_screen.dart
Wrap the campaign insert call in try-catch and show a SnackBar on error
Add validation UX: show SnackBar when title is empty or budget is invalid instead of silently doing nothing

In admin_profile_screen.dart, replace AppColors.background with theme.scaffoldBackgroundColor, AppColors.textPrimary with theme.colorScheme.onSurface, AppColors.textSecondary with theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withOpacity(0.6)
In subscriptions_provider.dart, add debugPrint('Subscriptions error: $e') before returning empty list in both catch blocks
In admin_profile_screen.dart, await the signOut() call before navigating: await ref.read(authProvider.notifier).signOut(); if (context.mounted) context.go('/login');
acceptance_criteria: Campaign insert includes created_by field with current user ID
Campaign creation shows SnackBar on error
Campaign dialog shows validation SnackBars for empty title or invalid budget
AdminProfileScreen uses Theme.of(context) colors, not hardcoded AppColors for text/background
Subscriptions provider logs errors with debugPrint before returning empty list
signOut() is awaited before navigating to /login
verification: All three modified files have correct Dart syntax
findings: All 5 review issues addressed in a single commit. signOut() in auth_provider.dart is Future<void> so it must be awaited. AdminProfileScreen kept AppColors.primary for accent color (role badge, avatar) since that is a semantic accent shared across themes. Only text colors and backgrounds were converted to theme-aware values.
